q: How do I calculate a mushroom farm's carbon footprint per kg?
title: Mushroom farm carbon per kg
short: Add electricity for air conditioning, humidifiers and cold rooms at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh and generator or boiler fuel, then divide by kg of mushrooms sold. Climate-controlled growing rooms usually make electricity the main on-farm source; compost materials are bought-in inputs.

ul: Electricity for growing-room cooling, humidifiers and fans.
Boiler fuel for compost pasteurisation, where used.
Straw, manure and other compost materials.

p: Divide by kg of fresh mushrooms sold. Composting itself releases some methane and N2O; note it as a known gap if you do not calculate it.

example.title: Worked example: button mushroom farm (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Add compost materials and spawn for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your bills and dispatch records.

senseible: Senseible reads diesel, electricity and fertiliser invoices into dated, fingerprinted records that support a farm or crop figure. Field emissions such as N2O and methane are calculated with IPCC defaults in your method note and labelled as estimates, not measured values.
